g.text: Primary navigation is resource-oriented; list/detail/edit are within-view modes.
Procurement, catalogue activation, allocation, and order actions retain business semantics.
Role guards are absent because authorization policy is unresolved.
search, create, review, edit, or correct
search, design, version, activate, or withdraw
search, review, prepare, secure, or update
search, review, procure, allocate, or reconcile
